verdict.rationale: Relay supports recurring/automated financial workflows — auto-transfer rules moving cash by percentage/dollar amount, recurring invoices, and multi-step approval automation — which is genuine automation-depth for routine financial tasks. However there's no evidence of an API, webhook, or agent-facing mechanism for an AI-native user to programmatically schedule or orchestrate jobs; automation is confined to built-in banking rules configured via the app UI. Missing for 10: API/webhook access for AI agents to create/trigger recurring workflows, evidence of programmatic job scheduling, and independent confirmation these automation rules work reliably (community notes 'you still need to manually execute external payments').
